ops.oldText: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
ops.newText: (a) Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination and Company shall have no early termination charge or other penalty. Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason only at a time when there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, upon ninety (90) days advance written notice to Company.

input.comment: [Playbook] We need a clear right to exit for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, including while a Statement of Work is running, and Contractor's convenience right should not allow it to walk away from active work on 15 days' notice. As a fallback we can accept 60 days' notice for Company, but Contractor's convenience right must remain limited to periods with no outstanding Statement of Work on 90 days' notice.
input.summary: Give Company a 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund; limit Contractor's convenience right to when no SOW is outstanding on 90 days' notice.
